title: MCP services
intro: MCP servers for AI assistants. Connect an MCP client (Streamable HTTP) to a service's endpoint below. The services are read-only.
ecosystemIntro: Search CKAN extensions and see which portals run them, from the CKAN ecosystem data datHere publish on GitHub (MIT).
limits: A proof of concept: no sign-in, no availability promise; it may be rate-limited or taken down. The arguments of each call (the search text, for example) are logged.
status: Not affiliated with the onData association; the engine is derived from their ckan-mcp-server (MIT).
